verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that CrewAI is a framework and platform for developers to build their own agents and crews. Its documented delegation is between agents ("Delegate tasks when allowed", "delegating tasks among coworkers"), and Crew Studio and the Visual Agent Builder are no-code builders. None of this is a built-in AI assistant inside the product that a user can hand tasks to. User-built agents are developer building blocks and agent-to-agent delegation is an adjacent feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
